case_title: DAYRIT, PEDRO C. VS MAITA TOYOTA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $999.00 FILED BY DAYRIT, PEDRO C. AS TO DEFENDANT MAITA TOYOTA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-22-1999 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERTIFIED MAIL TO PAUL DUPAN, MAITA TOYOTA RETURNED SIGNED;
THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT MAITA TOYOTA IMPROPER VENUE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
